status: Uncompiled startup v2 Source with deployed epoch/double performance; no engine/guest admission.
moduleContract: Full pinned Node22 export-name record. Both specifier aliases bind the same actual default object/functions; process global equals default. Explicit partial behavior and limitations follow.

node:os.callablePolicy: Supported finite methods use real guest algorithms/native providers. Enumerated unsupported callables throw own coded ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED on call or construction; no host builtin adapters.
deviations: No host CPU/NIC/RAM/hostname information is fabricated. cpus=[] means unavailable, consistent with Node getCPUs()||[]; availableParallelism refuses.
arch=wasm32,platform=wasi,type=WASI,endianness=LE,EOL=\n are explicit guest ABI constants, not host facts.
homedir requires actual deployed HOME absolute path; tmpdir uses deployed env and POSIX /tmp fallback, without claiming that path is preopened.
constants.errno is a finite set compiled from actual guest errno.h. Signal/priority/dlopen/host constants are omitted; devNull is explicitly undefined until a real guest sink exists.
